limitations: Assisted game flight, bounded pitch/bank; not certified performance or exact cockpit replicas.
No autorotation, vortex-ring model, fuel/engine systems, aerobatics, weapons or crash deformation.
Physics uses coarse airframe probes against nearby resident geometry; imported hull extraction is capped at 128.
Cockpit controls are operated by the documented input bindings; most physical switches are visual details.
Session-local raised practice airfield; aircraft positions do not persist through page reload.
visualReview: Rendered the imported model under an AgX/physical-sky rig at three-quarter front, side, top, front, underside, chase (gear up, level and banked), cockpit and close-ups of the windscreen, scoop, gear and tail, and with flaps, ailerons, elevators and rudder deflected. Proportions match the P-51D (9.83 m by 11.28 m); the teardrop canopy, three-panel windscreen, ventral scoop, dorsal fillet, glove and squared tips read from the chase camera. Opaque sides still enclose the seat below the sill and the windscreen keeps the forward view clear.
